create_inverted_pendulum: create an InvertedPendulum robot environment with a single pole and cart slider
create_inverted_double_pendulum: create an InvertedDoublePendulum robot environment with two poles and a cart slider
apply_action_inverted_pendulum: apply a clipped motor torque action to the inverted pendulum slider joint
calc_state_inverted_pendulum: calculate the 5-dim state vector including position, velocity, and pole angle
reset_inverted_double_pendulum: reset the inverted double pendulum with randomized hinge positions and zero torque
